🚨 Accenture + MNC Data Engineer interviews in 2026 are on another level now.
I reviewed the latest Azure Data Engineering interview questions…
 and one thing became crystal clear 👇
👉 Companies are NOT hiring “tool users” anymore.
 👉 They are hiring problem solvers.
📌 (The guide focuses on real Azure Data Engineering scenarios with ADF, Databricks, Delta Lake & Synapse)
🔥 One of the MOST asked questions:
👉 “Explain your end-to-end Azure Data Engineering architecture.”
Most candidates say:
 ❌ “We used ADF and Databricks…”
That’s NOT enough anymore.
💥 What strong candidates explain:
✔️ Source Systems → ADF Pipelines
 ✔️ ADLS Gen2 → Raw Storage
 ✔️ Databricks → Bronze → Silver → Gold transformations
 ✔️ Synapse SQL Pool → Curated analytics
 ✔️ Power BI → Reporting
👉 THAT shows architecture thinking.
🔥 Real Production Scenario They Asked:
A retail client processed:
 ✔️ 20M+ transactions daily
 ✔️ Multiple ERP systems
 ✔️ Near real-time dashboards
🚨 Problem?
 Pipeline runtime = 3 HOURS
💡 Solution:
 ✔️ Parallel activities in ADF
 ✔️ Spark optimization
 ✔️ Delta Lake partitioning
🔥 Result:
 Execution time reduced from 3 hours → 40 minutes
📌 (This exact optimization scenario is explained in the guide)
💥 Another favorite interview trap:
👉 “ADF vs Databricks?”
Wrong answer:
 ❌ “Both are ETL tools”
Correct mindset:
 ✔️ ADF = orchestration
 ✔️ Databricks = large-scale transformation
👉 They WORK TOGETHER.
